political_system.type: Federal parliamentary constitutional republic with influential military establishment
political_system.executive: Prime Minister is head of government holding executive power, commanding the majority of the National Assembly; President is ceremonial head of state.
political_system.legislature: Bicameral Parliament (Majlis-e-Shoora) comprising the National Assembly (336 seats elected via first-past-the-post and reserved seats) and Senate (100 seats representing the four provinces equally).
political_system.judiciary: Supreme Court of Pakistan, provincial High Courts, and Federal Shariat Court; judicial assertiveness has historically played a prominent role in political dismissals and constitutional disputes.
political_system.structure: Federal republic comprising four provinces (Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan), the Islamabad Capital Territory, and the autonomous administrative territories of Azad Jammu & Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan.
political_system.election_system: First-past-the-post for National Assembly general seats; proportional representation for reserved seats for women and non-Muslims; administered by the Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP).

current_government.ruling_coalition: Pakistan Democratic Movement (PDM) alliance, led by Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N) and Pakistan People's Party (PPP)
current_government.army_chief: Field Marshal / General Asim Munir (Chief of Army Staff - COAS)
current_government.context: Formed following the contentious February 2024 general elections; operates under close civil-military coordination formalized via the Special Investment Facilitation Council (SIFC) to manage economic stabilization, privatization, and external sovereign investment.
current_government.main_opposition: Sunni Ittehad Council / Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) affiliated independents backing imprisoned former PM Imran Khan

major_parties.name: Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N)
major_parties.ideology: Centre-right, fiscal conservatism, infrastructure modernization, industrial business interests

major_parties.name: Pakistan People's Party (PPP)
major_parties.ideology: Centre-left, social democracy, constitutional federalism, strong base in Sindh province
major_parties.status: Key coalition partner holding the Presidency

major_parties.name: Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI)
major_parties.ideology: Populism, anti-establishment welfare nationalism, sovereign foreign policy autonomy
major_parties.status: Largest opposition voting bloc; base in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and urban Punjab

major_parties.name: Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan (MQM-P)
major_parties.ideology: Secular regionalism representing Urdu-speaking Muhajir urban communities in Karachi and Hyderabad

political_movements_and_dynamics.name: Civil-Military Governance and SIFC
political_movements_and_dynamics.description: The Special Investment Facilitation Council (SIFC), composed of civilian ministers and the Army Chief, institutionalizes a joint framework to bypass bureaucratic hurdles, attract sovereign wealth from Gulf states, and assure foreign investors of long-term policy continuity.
political_movements_and_dynamics.current_relevance: Drives privatization of state-owned enterprises, mineral extraction deals (Reko Diq copper-gold project), and agriculture modernization.

political_movements_and_dynamics.name: IMF Stabilization vs. Domestic Cost-of-Living
political_movements_and_dynamics.description: Balancing stringent IMF Extended Fund Facility conditions (energy tariff hikes, widening the tax net, currency market flexibility) against intense public pressure regarding inflation, utility costs, and youth unemployment.
political_movements_and_dynamics.current_relevance: Dictates national macroeconomic policy, fiscal budgets, and external balance-of-payments survival.

political_movements_and_dynamics.name: Internal Security in Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
political_movements_and_dynamics.description: Counter-insurgency operations against Baloch separatists (Baloch Liberation Army [BLA] targeting CPEC and Chinese nationals) and Islamist militants (Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan [TTP] staging cross-border attacks from eastern Afghanistan).
political_movements_and_dynamics.current_relevance: Crucial for safeguarding Chinese investments, deepwater port connectivity at Gwadar, and domestic political stability.
